title: AI Found a $500K WordPress Bug for Just $25
description:
AI just found a $500k-grade WordPress bug for 25 bucks 🔥

A Searchlight Cyber researcher used GPT 5.6 Sol Ultra to uncover a critical RCE in WordPress, in ten hours flat. The model chained five separate weaknesses on its own, from bypassing SQL protection to grabbing admin rights. Work that used to take a specialist weeks now takes one day 😅 The threat model just got rewritten.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
